accessibility.name: Take your pick into the shop.

texts: Six things on the shelf right now. Every price is the full price in pounds, nothing added at the counter.
A small bottle of cold-pressed lavender oil for the end of the day. Ten drops in a warm bath, or on the pillow.
For adults. Keep away from children and ask your doctor if you are pregnant.
Beeswax and shea, in a tin that fits a coat pocket. For gardeners and anyone who washes up a lot.
Grown on a small farm near Frome, dried slowly and packed in paper. Bright and grassy, good after a heavy meal.
A food, not a medicine. Not for children under 2.
Twelve kinds of seed for a strip of lawn or a window box, with a small card on when to sow and what will come up.
A little tin of balm with a hint of honey. Sold in singles and in a pack of three for a few pence less.
Pressed rosehip with a drop of vitamin E, in a dark glass bottle with a dropper. Three drops in the evening is plenty.
Patch test first if your skin is sensitive.
Take your pick into the shop.
Signing up takes a minute. Then you can put things in a basket and pay at the checkout.
Everyday goods and small prices from Donkey.

texts: Six things on the shelf right now. Every price is the full price in pounds, nothing added at the counter.
A small bottle of cold-pressed lavender oil for the end of the day. Ten drops in a warm bath, or on the pillow.
For adults. Keep away from children and ask your doctor if you are pregnant.
Beeswax and shea, in a tin that fits a coat pocket. For gardeners and anyone who washes up a lot.
Grown on a small farm near Frome, dried slowly and packed in paper. Bright and grassy, good after a heavy meal.
A food, not a medicine. Not for children under 2.
Twelve kinds of seed for a strip of lawn or a window box, with a small card on when to sow and what will come up.
A little tin of balm with a hint of honey. Sold in singles and in a pack of three for a few pence less.
Pressed rosehip with a drop of vitamin E, in a dark glass bottle with a dropper. Three drops in the evening is plenty.
Patch test first if your skin is sensitive.
Take your pick into the shop.
Signing up takes a minute. Then you can put things in a basket and pay at the checkout.
Everyday goods and small prices from Donkey.
